en.headline: FEHD arrests nine for unlicensed hawking at helper gathering spots
en.dek: The Food and Environmental Hygiene Department detained nine people and seized about 1.5 tonnes of goods in the past two weeks after an earlier education phase.
body: The Food and Environmental Hygiene Department said on Monday it had arrested nine people suspected of unlicensed hawking and obstructing public places at foreign domestic helper gathering spots across the city over the past two weeks.

About 1.5 tonnes of goods were seized, including cooked food, clothing, hats, shoes, handbags and cosmetics. The nine detainees comprised two men and six women of non-Chinese ethnicity plus one Chinese man, aged between 30 and 55. Two of the men held recognisance forms that do not permit employment and one held a two-way permit.

The department said the first weeks of the month-long campaign focused on publicity and education, including multi-language leaflets distributed with help from relevant consulates. Enforcement followed in the most recent fortnight. FEHD will refer any suspected breach of stay conditions to other authorities.

Unlicensed hawking carries a maximum fine of HK$10,000 and six months’ imprisonment; obstruction can attract a further HK$25,000 fine or three months’ jail. Selling restricted foods without permission is also an offence.

zh.headline: 食環署外傭聚集點拘9人涉無牌擺賣
zh.dek: 過去兩周檢獲約1.5公噸貨物，包括熟食及衣物等；行動首數周以宣傳教育為主。
body: 食物環境衞生署周一表示，過去一個月持續於假日在各區外傭聚集地點針對無牌擺賣及阻礙通道加強執法。過去兩星期共拘控9名涉嫌無牌販賣並在公眾地方造成阻礙的人士，檢獲約1.5公噸貨物。
被拘控的9人包括2男6女非華裔人士及一名華裔男子，年齡介乎30至55歲。當中2名男子持有不允許僱傭工作的擔保書，另有一名男子持有往來港澳通行證。貨物包括熟食、衣服、帽、鞋、手袋及化妝品等。
署方指行動首數星期主要進行宣傳教育，聯同相關駐港總領事館派發多種語言單張，提醒無牌販賣屬違法。過去兩周才採取拘控行動。懷疑違反逗留條件的個案會通知相關執法部門跟進。
無牌販賣最高可處罰款1萬元及監禁6個月；同時阻礙通道另可處罰款2.5萬元或監禁3個月。
